decision: Use finalWorth; keep rank as descriptive metadata
reason: finalWorth is the target wealth measure; rank is ordinal and can tie, so it is not the main response.

variables: age, birthYear, birthMonth, birthDay, birthDate, date
decision: Use age; treat date as snapshot metadata; avoid month/day in main models
reason: Age has substantive life-cycle meaning; date is not a panel; birth month/day add little statistical value.

variables: country, city, state, residenceStateRegion, countryOfCitizenship, latitude_country, longitude_country
decision: Use country for clustering/strata; interpret state/residenceStateRegion as US-structured; avoid causal citizenship claims
reason: country is central but countryOfCitizenship changes the estimand; state fields are structurally available mainly for US records.

decision: Use category as canonical; keep source descriptive; avoid organization/title in main inference
reason: category and industries are duplicate labels; organization/title have very high missingness and unstable semantics.

variables: selfMade, status, gender, personName, firstName, lastName
decision: Use selfMade and gender cautiously; treat status as descriptive unless codebook is verified; names are identifiers only
reason: selfMade/gender support group comparisons; status labels lack a trusted external coding manual.

decision: Derive log_gdp and log_pop; avoid interpreting GDP as development without population controls
reason: GDP mixes economic scale with population; models need scale/development separation.
